title: Ferry Fire Off Indonesia Claims Lives of at Least 5, Leaves 41 Missing
summary: A ferry carrying 271 people caught fire off the coast of Madura island in Indonesia, resulting in the deaths of at least five people. The vessel was on a journey from Indonesia to Malaysia when it encountered the blaze. Rescue efforts are underway with multiple ships deployed to assist. The cause of the fire is currently unknown.
summary_points: Ferry carrying 271 people caught fire off Madura island in Indonesia
At least five people died in the incident
Rescue efforts are underway with multiple ships deployed
